name: PivotMatrix
tagline: Pivot Matrix turns a list of records into an Excel-style summary table right inside your app.
description: Pivot Matrix turns a list of records into an Excel-style summary table right inside your app. You choose one column for the rows (for example Category), one for the columns (for example Order date or Status) and, optionally, a value to add up (for example Amount). Every cell shows the total, count or average for that combination, shaded like a heat map so the big numbers stand out.
features: Rows by one column (with optional expandable sub-rows)
Columns by another (dates grouped by day / week / month / quarter / year)
Count / sum / average / min / max of a value column, heat-map colouring, threshold highlight
Top N + Other, search, swap axes
Click-a-cell drill-down to the records behind it (open record), CSV export
Keyboard grid navigation and a phone card layout
Its records and totals for canvas filters
